notes: When the challenge opens

A script opens it only if the auditor's delta is not empty. Otherwise writing follows directly. The discussion is a loop between the human and the auditor, with no maximum number of rounds: at each round, the auditor receives the delta and the messages exchanged since its last round.
The Build is in the workflow

The Build steps are taken as-is in this workflow, from TDD implementation to the merge, excluding e2e tests. Everything it verifies therefore applies identically. The Recette remains a separate workflow, launched by hand.
Why a single workflow

The human who requested the express is still there. If the build meets an impossible criterion or an uncovered choice, they answer right away and can change the need without going back through Need: the writer fixes the provisional, the gate replays, then the build resumes at the implementer, who redoes their tests.
No splitting

Splitting is done by Plan, which the express bypasses. An express need, even a large one, gives a single story, one PR and one Recette. This is where the express saves time, not by lightening the checks.
Provisional, then catch-up
A criterion or ADR written in express carries status provisional, visible as such. The catch-up is created by script with a deadline, and its alert fires at expiry.
No e2e tests
The Express does not go through the end-of-build e2e tests: the dev keeps the tests written first, and the Recette verifies the behavior.
What the express never bypasses

Validation and the review gate, the CI, the technical-frame rules, the dev's tests written before the code, the diff within scope, the lock, the code review, the Recette. It never modifies a frame, and a contradiction with an accepted ADR or guideline refuses it.
The express right
It is reserved to designated accounts: the platform opens this workflow only to them.
The discussion and the gate

The requester talks with the auditor and answers the writer if it is blocked. At the gate, they see the provisional ticket, need entry, ADR and log, and can send everything back to the writer. No maximum number of rounds. The provisional is caught up afterwards by Need or Plan, which have their own gate.
What refuses the express
A modified frame, a contradiction with an accepted ADR or guideline, or a ticket already open on the criteria concerned: the need then goes through the standard workflow.
doc.lede: A simplified path to go fast: a fix, a core feature, any need the human chooses not to route through Need and Plan. The workflow writes provisional documentation, creates a single story without tasks and builds it in the same workflow: if a problem appears, the need is changed live. It bypasses neither the CI, nor the rules, nor the tests written first, nor the code review.
